item.title: Litter and rubbish in this area, 24th August
item.description:
Please can something be done about the condition of Edgehill Road, SE18. There is lots of rubbish and litter across the grass bank. The litter has been there for weeks and I am unclear why this bank does not receive regular litter picking. The house clearance store on the corner is also leaving dumped furniture outside the store on evenings and weekends- and there is now a metal can for burning rubbish left outside the store. I think the store is connect to the man who owns the vans which are always piled high with rubbish on the street- so Edgehill seems to have become the place he leaves rubbish from both the vans and the shop now. These are commercial enterprises and should not be allowed to impact on a residential street. Please can both these issues be resolved. Thank you
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Edge Hill, Woolwich
Report on FixMyStreet
